Folia runtimes / visualizers — personal-use copy
===============================================
These files are extracted from the locally installed Folia application
(D:\folia\resources\app.asar) for the owner's personal, non-distributed
use in this player.

Folia is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0).
If this player is ever distributed or used as a network service, the AGPL
obligations (source disclosure and license preservation) apply.
Do not redistribute this directory as part of a closed-source product.

The original Folia copyright and license notices remain in the extracted
files and in the licenses/ directory.

noLyricLines-Dn3DI4dd.js has a minimal local patch that exposes Folia's
bundled ReactDOM createRoot for mounting the original React visualizers
(Tilt / Claddagh / Cadenza) inside this player. No Folia code is relicensed.
